mcqs.q: Is the result of 8 x 0.4 larger or smaller than 8?
options: Larger, because multiplying always makes numbers bigger.
The same as 8, because 0.4 is too small to change anything.
Smaller — multiplying by a number between 0 and 1 makes the result smaller (the answer is 3.2).
3x - 12, by multiplying 3 by everything inside.

mcqs.q: What is the magnitude of the vector (3, 4)?
options: The magnitude is 7 — you add the components.
3x - 12, by multiplying 3 by everything inside.
The magnitude is 12 — you multiply the components.
5 — using sqrt(3^2 + 4^2).
3 - x - 4 = -1 - x, by only applying the minus to the first term inside.
The same as 8, because 0.4 is too small to change anything.
7 - x — the minus sign outside the bracket changes the sign of every term inside (3 - x + 4).
3x - 12, by multiplying 3 by everything inside.
